section_summary.extract_value: This paper reports a single study (N = 186) of female undergraduates from two private Christian colleges testing whether perceived relationship with God moderates the inverse relationship between social comparison (body, eating, exercise) and body appreciation. Results indicated frequent body-related comparisons were related to lower body appreciation, and this association was conditional on the quality of women's perceived relationship with God.
